_about: Lunch places shown in Luncheon. 'reader' names the function in scripts/read-menus.mjs that reads the menu; 'fixed' places have the same menu every day and are entered by hand. Coordinates are from OpenStreetMap. Uni3 uses the Lindholmspiren 3 building and Bistrot the Diagonalen street, so their walking times are approximate. Oishii's location is not filled in yet.
